Card Q&A.q: This card's [On Play] effect places a Digimon card from my hand under 1 of my Digimon. Can I place it under this Digimon?

Card Q&A.a: No. It enters play as a new Digimon, unsuspended. Additionally, it does not carry over any effects on the source Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: This card's [On Play] effect plays a level 3 Digimon card from the digivolution cards of a suspended Digimon. Does the level 3 Digimon enter play suspended?

Effect: [On Play] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card from one of your Digimon's digivolution cards as another Digimon without paying its memory cost. If you do, you may place 1 blue Digimon card from your hand at the bottom of one of your Digimon's digivolution cards.
